matches_with_result AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    home_team_goal,
    away_team_goal,
    team,
    player_api_id,
    CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'home'
         WHEN home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 'away'
         ELSE NULL END as result
  FROM player_as_matches
),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    player_api_id,
    team,
    result,
    COUNT(*) as participation_count
  FROM matches_with_result
  WHERE result IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY player_api_id, team, result
)
SELECT 
  p.player_name,
  ps.team,
  ps.result,
  ps.participation_count
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = ps.player_api_id
WHERE 
  (ps.result = 'home' AND ps.participation_count = (SELECT MAX(participation_count) FROM player_stats WHERE result = 'home'))
  OR (ps.result = 'away' AND ps.participation_count = (SELECT MAX(participation_count) FROM player_stats WHERE result = 'away'))
ORDER BY ps.result, ps.participation_count DESC
